title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a manuscript note on PD de Rham complexes. It is a typed page, numbered '- 130 -' and headed 'IX', from Grothendieck's SGA 7 I, Exposé IX ('Modèles de Néron et monodromie'). The neighbouring pages are handwritten notes on integrating simplicial differential graded groups, so this page appears to be misfiled in cote 136.

End of §10.4. Setting: A_K is an abelian variety over the fraction field K of a henselian DVR with residue field k (characteristic p). A is its Néron model and A' that of the dual. M and M' are the character groups of the toric parts of the special fibres A_0^0 and A'_0^0. (10.4.1) is the monodromy pairing M × M' → Z. A polarization ξ induces an isogeny ξ̃_0 and hence ξ_{0t}: M⊗Q ≅ M'⊗Q. Composing gives a bilinear form φ^t_ξ on M. The page argues:
- φ^t_ξ is symmetric and positive if φ^t_{ξ_0} is.
- Non-degeneracy of φ^t_{ξ_0} is equivalent to (10.4.1) being separating, so it is independent of the polarization.
- To check separation it suffices to do so for the ℓ-adic monodromy pairing u_ℓ (9.1.2) for a single prime ℓ.
- For ℓ ≠ p, the description of u_ℓ in 9.2 (via the variation map on Tate modules) makes left-separation trivial. Two-sided separation then follows because rank M = rank M'.

Start of §11 ('Composantes connexes du modèle de Néron : relation de dualité, comportement asymptotique'). This introduces the finite étale k-group Φ_0 = A_0/A_0^0 and its decomposition into ℓ-primary parts, Φ_0 = ∐_ℓ Φ_0(ℓ). The section goes on to construct Grothendieck's pairing Φ × Φ' → Q/Z, prove its perfectness on prime-to-p parts, conjecture it in general, and describe Φ via the monodromy pairing in the semistable case. All of this is published SGA 7 material.
errors: Original typo: 'assymptotique' should be 'asymptotique'. There is no mathematical error on this page.

ideas.what: Monodromy pairing M × M' → Z for semistable abelian varieties, its non-degeneracy, and compatibility with polarizations (positivity of the induced form)
Reduction of non-degeneracy to the ℓ-adic monodromy pairing u_ℓ for one ℓ ≠ p
Component group Φ = A_0/A_0^0 of the Néron model and its ℓ-primary decomposition, introducing the duality study
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck, SGA 7 IX §11 (perfectness proved later by McCallum, Bégueri, Bertapelle, Bosch and others; counterexamples by Bertapelle-Bosch for non-perfect residue fields)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typescript page of published SGA 7 Exp. IX (page 130), apparently misfiled among the 1975-76 PD de Rham notes. Its content is standard and fully published.
transcription_corrections: The page is typed SGA 7 Exp. IX, p. 130, not a handwritten note. The '448' marks are archive stamps, and the '54' at bottom left is the archive page number.
'comportement assymptotique' is the original spelling, not a transcription error.
